title: Planner model inputs omit owner-photo metadata without changing other steps or replaying a historical paid run
steps: Run the planner brief-view and approved-prompt tests without a database or model.
expect: Both image-enabled and text-only planner inputs omit assets while preserving facts, evidence, missing information, readiness, acceptance, sitemap and owner contracts.
The raw brief is immutable and brand, writer and picture input builders retain their previous inputs.
Missing, historical or unknown view versions refuse before preparation I/O or conversation reconstruction.
The approved system prompt and required image-review tools remain intact.
fence: Only planner model messages use the versioned view; stored briefs and other consumers remain complete. No provider calls or database writes.

tests: planner model input omits assets with images=false
planner model input omits assets with images=true
a historical or unknown brief view refuses before preparation I/O and before conversation reconstruction
the planner view preserves briefs without assets and does not alter nested owner or write contracts
the shipped planner prompt is the approved one, byte for byte
